rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical pressure, external pressure, psychological stress, and pressure to act quickly.

example.english: The pressure at work has been really intense lately.
example.traditional: 最近返工壓力真係好大。
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 faan1 gung1 aat3 lik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this technical physics term for force per unit area rather than everyday or emotional pressure.

example.english: This experiment requires calculating the pressure of the liquid.
example.traditional: 呢個實驗要計算液體嘅壓強。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sat6 jim6 jiu3 gai3 syun3 jik6 tai2 ge3 aat3 koeng4

rows.note: Use this when outside pressure is experienced as coercion or oppression, especially from poverty, taxes, or authority.

example.english: Many low-income families are under pressure from taxes.
example.traditional: 好多基層家庭都受到稅項壓迫。
example.jyutping: hou2 do1 gei1 cang4 gaa1 ting4 dou1 sau6 dou3 seoi3 hong6 aat3 bik1
